releases.notes:
Unofficial Fabric 1.21.1 port of Portable Blueprints 2.0.10 by Nimblonia.

The new Fabric integration is written in Kotlin; original common Java logic, blueprint format, GUI and resources are reused. Mixin classes remain Java.

## Downloads

- `portable-blueprints-fabric-1.21.1-install.zip`: the mod plus the tested Fabric API and Fabric Language Kotlin dependencies.
- `portable-blueprints-2.0.10-fabric.1+1.21.1.jar`: mod only.
- `portable-blueprints-fabric-1.21.1-source.zip`: complete buildable project, Gradle wrapper and development tests.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: checksums for these files.

Requires Minecraft 1.21.1, Java 21+, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+. Install on both client and server. Do not install the original NeoForge JAR alongside this port.

## Validation

`runSmokeClient build` passed. All four required Fabric GameTests passed, covering survival scan/save/build/material consumption, linked-chest extraction, packet ownership checks, and upstream blueprint coordinate JSON compatibility. The real client opened the scanner/tablet and rendered opaque/translucent blueprint VBOs in an isolated flat world; screenshots were inspected.

## Limits

NeoForge-specific ProjectE/Sophisticated Backpacks integrations are disabled. Configuration uses JSON; TOML migration is not implemented. NeoForge ModelData-specific models and arbitrary modpacks have not been verified. Runtime validation was on macOS arm64; Windows/Linux production execution has not been tested.

Original mod: https://modrinth.com/mod/portable-blueprints
